reviews.reason: Native legacy visual retention does not prove the build-based diagram/SmartArt semantic inventory is exercised.
reviews.required_evidence: An editable DiagramBuildContainer/DiagramBuildAtom owner with its associated OfficeArt shape references in the legacy slide.
reviews.observed_evidence: The SMARTART_PROCESS_002 slide has placeholder 4097 and picture 4098. Its 47633-byte PNG hashes to a018e672221c348c6b90c9ed6611f42e2a2333f5b668a3425843bdf2cf348ca7. The PPT file has only SlideTime10Atom in PPT10 metadata; its PPS/POT derivatives have no PPT10 records, and diagram projection returns Refused(UnsupportedTarget).
reviews.scope_limit: This proves the saved picture representation and absence of the supported build owner; it does not claim every possible opaque SmartArt compatibility record is absent, or that a picture/empty inventory qualifies diagram semantics. A native build-bearing legacy specimen remains needed.

reviews.reason: The closed native legacy export has a User Names stream, but its UsrChk version is outside the documented BIFF2-BIFF8 enumeration; presence alone does not establish a typed user-log or publication success.
reviews.required_evidence: A native XLS User Names stream with a documented UsrChk version (0200/0300/0400/0500/0600), valid Revision Log dependencies and, for nonempty user reads, at least one retained UsrInfo entry.
reviews.observed_evidence: The 536-byte stream has CUsr=0, UsrChk bytes 06 00 00 00, a 512-byte CbUsr table whose inactive first size slot is 41, and BCUsrs=0. Snapshot::parse reports InvalidRecord 0x0198 for version 0x0006. The associated legacy Revision Log also contains duplicate-zero RRTabId maps; the final workbook values remain readable.
reviews.scope_limit: Fixture-profile evidence only, never positive semantic coverage or a claim that User Names is generally unsupported. Native bytes and historical authoring classifications remain unchanged; a conforming native user-log specimen remains required.

reviews.reason: Ordinary pictures and native text bullets do not establish a BlipCollection9 picture-bullet owner. The current package editor requires an existing collection.
reviews.required_evidence: A native PPT with a BlipCollection9/BlipEntity9 collection and text-style picture-bullet references, including an unreferenced entry or a supported reference-removal scenario for CRUD.
reviews.observed_evidence: All 11 binary PowerPoint manifest fixtures, including explicit read-only decryption of the encrypted PPT, have no live picture-bullet collection. Document binary tags contain neither collection nor entry records. The ten unencrypted packages refuse removal from the absent owner and retain exact bytes on no-op publication.
reviews.scope_limit: Evidence-only corpus gap: absence/refusal does not qualify native picture-bullet semantics or declare the implemented codecs unsupported. Native collection and dependency fixtures remain needed; no source files or historical status are changed.

reviews.reason: The native math DOC contains EMF fallbacks and has no Equation.3/MTEF ObjectPool; picture representations are not equation semantics.
